Aha's HP is always at <unbreak>100%</unbreak>! Aha's DMG Boost is increased by <unbreak>5[i]%</unbreak>.

Greatly increases On-Field Strength.

***"Aha's forty-kilometer blade has been waiting for this moment!"***
Increases ally squad's on-field/off-field strength by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.
At the start of combat, increases Aha's Lucky Strike DMG by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>.
After Aha and Elation characters use Elation Skills to defeat <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> enemies, DMG Amplification is increased by <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>.

After Aha and Elation characters use Elation Skills to defeat an enemy, gains <unbreak>6[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Red Eye": DMG Amplification increases by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> and HP Amplification increases by <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>. In each battle, starts with <unbreak>5[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Red Eye."

Recovers 1 Skill Point at the start of Aha's turn. That's it, nothing more.

Greatly increases Off-Field Strength.

The ally squad gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation.
After entering combat, enemies become "Weakened," reducing their DMG dealt by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>.

When an on-field ally's HP drops below <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, Aha provides a Shield equal to <unbreak>5[i]%</unbreak> of Aha's DEF that lasts for <unbreak>6[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect can be triggered up to <unbreak>7[i]</unbreak> time(s). When on-field allies have Shield, they are immune to action delay effects.
